title: Craft and Create
description: Craft and Create is a Modded Minecraft Survival Multiplayer Server Im inviting folks to join if they'd like to try out the create mod and  a varity of its Addons as well as a few other mods of choice.
body:
**Craft and Create** is a Modded Minecraft Survival Multi-Player Server heavily focused around the Create Mod (with fan favorite addons such as Create Aeronautics, Copycats+, and many more) as well as several mods to help diversify the survival experience such as Artifacts, Spawn, and the Naturalist Mods; and support for several quality of life mods such as Appleskin, Xearo's Maps, Discord & Chat Images, and so much more! join the Discord for more information!

*Note:* This is a family friendly server, welcoming of all ages; but all players are expected to be behaved and to not steal from, attack, or otherwise grief other players.
